response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical skills and experience across multiple languages and ecosystems, but lacks direct experience with JVM tooling, enterprise frameworks (e.g., Spring), and IDE internals. His expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, and other languages is valuable, but the resume does not highlight Java/Kotlin, build tools (Maven/Gradle), or application server integrations. His leadership and collaboration skills are evident, but the core technical alignment with the role is weak.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship and TDD practices
Diverse experience with large-scale systems and high-performance applications
Proven leadership in technical workshops and open-source contributions
concerns: No explicit experience with Java/Kotlin, Spring, or JVM ecosystem tooling
Limited evidence of IDE internals or language tooling development
Primary expertise in non-JVM languages (TypeScript, Node.js, D) may not align with enterprise Java tooling needs
